name: Jockey Hollow Day Camp
operator_name: Girl Scouts of Northern New Jersey
description_short: Girl Scout day camp on 212 acres in Mendham for girls in kindergarten through grade 9. Campers swim in the camp pool, hike into Jockey Hollow in Morristown National Historical Park, explore streams, do archery, low ropes and a zip line, and can add a horse program.

fees.name: Aftercare
fees.note: Per one week session; $72 for the four day Session 1

notes: Core program is $545 a week ($435 for the four day Session 1). Badge specialty weeks are $585, horse programs $815 (All About Horses, grades 1 to 3) and $835 (Tack and Trails, grades 4 to 8), and two week CIT sessions $720. Add ons: aftercare $90 a week ($72 for Session 1), Twilight Camp Time $60, Starlight Overnight $100 for grade 3 and up. Campers are grouped as Summer Explorers (K to 1), Discoverers (2 to 3) and Adventurers (4 to 9); rising kindergartners must be 5 by the session. 2027 registration opens December 7, 2026.
